package handler

import (
	"context"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/aws/aws-sdk-go-v2/service/s3"
)

// scenario for s3_listobjects_without_pagination: `s3.ListObjectsV2` without `MaxKeys` or pagination in handler code
// fixture polarity: positive; family: library; severity: warning.
func ListFilesHandler(s3Client *s3.Client, bucket string) http.HandlerFunc {
	return func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
		prefix := r.URL.Query().Get("prefix")

		input := &s3.ListObjectsV2Input{
			Bucket: &bucket,
			Prefix: &prefix,
		}
		output, err := s3Client.ListObjectsV2(context.Background(), input)
		if err != nil {
			http.Error(w, "failed to list objects", http.StatusInternalServerError)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
		for _, obj := range output.Contents {
			w.Write([]byte(*obj.Key + "\n"))
		}
	}
}
